articles.title: Johnson & Johnson Announces Quarterly Dividend for First Quarter 2026
articles.mainIdea: Johnson & Johnson Announces Quarterly Dividend for First Quarter 2026
articles.summary: Business Wire: Johnson & Johnson Announces Quarterly Dividend for First Quarter 2026. NEW BRUNSWICK, N.J., January 02, 2026--Johnson & Johnson (NYSE: JNJ) today announced that its Board of Directors has declared a cash dividend for the first quarter of 2026 of $1.30 per share on the company’s common stock. The dividend is payable on March 10, 2026 to shareholders of record at the close of business on February 24, 2026. The ex-dividend date is February 24, 2026.
